Class Donations

java.lang.Object
Donations
Direct Known Subclasses:
Monthly, OneTime, Pledge
public abstract class Donations extends Object
Abstract base class representing a donation made to a non-profit organization. All donations have an amount and a creation date/time. Subclasses define how the donation amount is calculated for a given year.
